dialogues.jp: 「さてと、メシメシ……」
dialogues.en: "Time for food..."
dialogues.text: "Time for food..."

dialogues.jp:
パンをお手玉のように放り投げながら、どこで
食べようかと考える。教室か、屋上か、それと
も中庭か……。
dialogues.en:
With packet bread in hand, I start thinking about where to
eat. The classroom, the roof... the courtyard, maybe?
dialogues.text:
With packet bread in hand, I start thinking about where to
eat. The classroom, the roof... the courtyard, maybe?

dialogues.jp: 「うん？　あの帽子は、ことりか？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? That hat, is it Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? That hat, is it Kotori?"

dialogues.jp:
校門に向かって、てくてくと歩く姿がある……
と言うか、あの帽子は目立つよな……。
dialogues.en:
A figure was trudging slowly out of school through the
school gates... That hat really makes her stand out...
dialogues.text:
A figure was trudging slowly out of school through the
school gates... That hat really makes her stand out...

dialogues.jp: 「あら？」
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp:
昼を食べる場所──ベンチとか──を探してい
るのかと思ったが、そのまま校門から出ようと
する。
dialogues.en:
Instead of searching for a lunchtime spot --a bench-- she
looked like she was leaving the school premises.
dialogues.text:
Instead of searching for a lunchtime spot --a bench-- she
looked like she was leaving the school premises.

dialogues.jp:
気になった俺は、追いかける事にした。間に合
うだろうか？
dialogues.en:
A little worried, I started chasing her. Would I be able to
catch her?
dialogues.text:
A little worried, I started chasing her. Would I be able to
catch her?

dialogues.jp: 「おーい！　ことり！」
dialogues.en: "Heeeey! Kotori!"
dialogues.text: "Heeeey! Kotori!"

dialogues.jp: 呼びかけながら、ダッシュする。
dialogues.en: I yelled at her while dashing.
dialogues.text: I yelled at her while dashing.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "......? Aah, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "......? Aah, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「サボりか？　校門から堂々ってのは、さすが
　にマズイんじゃないかな？」
dialogues.en:
"Skipping class? Just walking out of school like that will
mean trouble, won't it?"
dialogues.text:
"Skipping class? Just walking out of school like that will
mean trouble, won't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「サボりじゃないですよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm not playing truant."
dialogues.text: "I'm not playing truant."

dialogues.jp: 苦笑しつつ、小さく手を振った。
dialogues.en:
Kotori smiled slightly, and waved my remark off with her
hand.
dialogues.text:
Kotori smiled slightly, and waved my remark off with her
hand.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「立派な早退です……ちょっと、頭痛がして」
dialogues.en: "I got permission to leave... I have a headache."
dialogues.text: "I got permission to leave... I have a headache."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「我慢出来そうにないんですよ……早退とかは、
　ほんとは良くないんですけど」
dialogues.en:
"I tried to ignore it, but it just kept getting worse,
so..."
dialogues.text:
"I tried to ignore it, but it just kept getting worse,
so..."

dialogues.jp:
額を押さえ、顔をしかめる。言われてみると、
顔色も良くない。
dialogues.en:
She placed a hand on her forehead, with a frowning face. Now
that she says it, her face doesn't look good.
dialogues.text:
She placed a hand on her forehead, with a frowning face. Now
that she says it, her face doesn't look good.

dialogues.jp: 「頭痛、か」
dialogues.en: A headache, huh..."
dialogues.text: A headache, huh..."

dialogues.jp:
不肖の妹が病弱なせいか、どうもこの手の事は
気に掛かってしまう。
dialogues.en:
Having such an anaemic sister, I always worry about things
like this.
dialogues.text:
Having such an anaemic sister, I always worry about things
like this.

dialogues.jp: 「今から帰るって事は、昼飯とかは？」
dialogues.en: "If you're leaving now, what about your lunch?"
dialogues.text: "If you're leaving now, what about your lunch?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ご飯ですか？　食欲がないのって、お得なダ
　イエットですよね」
dialogues.en:
"Lunch? I don't have much of an appetite, so I might as well
go on a bit of a diet."
dialogues.text:
"Lunch? I don't have much of an appetite, so I might as well
go on a bit of a diet."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、なんか腹に入れといた方がいいと思う
　よ？　お菓子とかなら、食べられる？」
dialogues.en:
"But it'd be better to have something in your stomach, at
least... would you eat a pastry?"
dialogues.text:
"But it'd be better to have something in your stomach, at
least... would you eat a pastry?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　そうですね……」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Uhm, yes..."
dialogues.text: "Eh? Uhm, yes..."

dialogues.jp: ちょこんと首を傾げる。
dialogues.en: Kotori tilted her neck in puzzlement.
dialogues.text: Kotori tilted her neck in puzzlement.

dialogues.jp:
ともかく、嫌そうには見えないので、俺は｛・・／出す｝
事にした。
dialogues.en:
In any case, she doesn't look like she'd dislike it, so I
can make one come out.
dialogues.text:
In any case, she doesn't look like she'd dislike it, so I
can make one come out.

dialogues.jp: 背中に手を回して、どら焼きをイメージする。
dialogues.en:
I place a hand behind my back, and start visualizing a
dorayaki.
dialogues.text:
I place a hand behind my back, and start visualizing a
dorayaki.

dialogues.jp:
「さっき、購買で買ったんだ。良かったら食っ
　てくれ……って、包装開けちゃったけどな」
dialogues.en:
"I bought this earlier, so please eat it... um, although I
already removed the packaging."
dialogues.text:
"I bought this earlier, so please eat it... um, although I
already removed the packaging."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「わあ、どうも」
dialogues.en: "Wow, thank you!"
dialogues.text: "Wow, thank you!"

dialogues.jp:
受け取り、早速口にする。何だか子供みたいで
微笑ましい。
dialogues.en:
After receiving it, she promptly put it into her mouth. She
then gave a childlike smile.
dialogues.text:
After receiving it, she promptly put it into her mouth. She
then gave a childlike smile.

dialogues.jp:
口をもぐもぐやりながら、俺の顔をじっと見つ
めてきた。
dialogues.en: Her mouth emitting light chewing noises, she looked at me.
dialogues.text: Her mouth emitting light chewing noises, she looked at me.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　汚くはないぞ」
dialogues.en: "Hm? It's not dirty, don't worry."
dialogues.text: "Hm? It's not dirty, don't worry."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ううん、そうじゃなくて……う〜ん、頭痛い
　し、ま、いいか……」
dialogues.en:
"No, that's not it... uhm, about the headache... well, it
doesn't matter anyway."
dialogues.text:
"No, that's not it... uhm, about the headache... well, it
doesn't matter anyway."

dialogues.jp:
｛いぶか／訝｝しげにしていたのが、一人で納得してしまっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Only one person here understood her weird speech then--
maybe zero.
dialogues.text:
Only one person here understood her weird speech then--
maybe zero.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃ、帰りますね。どら焼き、ごちそう
　さまです」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, I better go home. Thank you for the dorayaki!"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I better go home. Thank you for the dorayaki!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おう。お大事に」
dialogues.en: "Alright, take care."
dialogues.text: "Alright, take care."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ふう……ぶっ倒れる前に、バイバイ出来て良
　かった。空腹時のアレはきつい……」
dialogues.en: "Hoo... good thing she's gone now, that was close."
dialogues.text: "Hoo... good thing she's gone now, that was close."

dialogues.jp: ポケットからパンを取り出す。
dialogues.en: I take out the bread from my pocket.
dialogues.text: I take out the bread from my pocket.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「何がきついんです？」
dialogues.en: "What was close?"
dialogues.text: "What was close?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「んなの、決まってるだろ？　和菓子を……」
dialogues.en: "Isn't it obvious? Making wagashis..."
dialogues.text: "Isn't it obvious? Making wagashis..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「和菓子を？」
dialogues.en: "Making wagashis?"
dialogues.text: "Making wagashis?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……ってなに言わせるんだ美春！」
dialogues.en: "...what are you trying to say, Miharu!"
dialogues.text: "...what are you trying to say, Miharu!"

dialogues.jp:
俺の隣にぴょこっと立ち尽くす美春のほっぺた
を引っ張った。
dialogues.en:
I pinched her cheek, then pulled her away into a more
private place.
dialogues.text:
I pinched her cheek, then pulled her away into a more
private place.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「痛いですよ〜、朝倉先輩〜！」
dialogues.en: "That huuuurts!"
dialogues.text: "That huuuurts!"

dialogues.jp:
俺の手から逃れた美春が、非難がましい目で俺
を見る。
dialogues.en: Miharu managed to escape from my hand, and glared at me.
dialogues.text: Miharu managed to escape from my hand, and glared at me.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「うぅ。美春はなにも言わせてませんよぅ」
dialogues.en: "Uu, I wasn't trying to say anything!"
dialogues.text: "Uu, I wasn't trying to say anything!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、お前は｛アイエムエフ／ＩＭＦ｝並の狡猾さで俺の秘密を
　暴こうとしたぞ」
dialogues.en:
"I see, you're using the IMF to try and find out all my
secrets! How devious!"
dialogues.text:
"I see, you're using the IMF to try and find out all my
secrets! How devious!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「どんな狡猾さですか、それは。だいたい美春
　は、朝倉先輩の秘密なんて知りたくもないで
　すよ」
dialogues.en:
"Who's devious? Besides, I don't really care to know any of
your dirty secrets."
dialogues.text:
"Who's devious? Besides, I don't really care to know any of
your dirty secrets."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……そうはっきり言われると傷つくんだが」
dialogues.en: "...Your words wound me greatly."
dialogues.text: "...Your words wound me greatly."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「白河先輩、帰っちゃったんですねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Shirakawa-senpai went back early, didn't she..."
dialogues.text: "Shirakawa-senpai went back early, didn't she..."

dialogues.jp:
ハートブレイク中な俺を無視して、桜並木の向
こうに消えつつあることりを見る美春。
dialogues.en:
Ignoring my heartbreak, Miharu gazed at the Sakura Avenue
which Kotori eventually disappeared into.
dialogues.text:
Ignoring my heartbreak, Miharu gazed at the Sakura Avenue
which Kotori eventually disappeared into.

dialogues.jp: 「家でゆっくり休めば治るだろ」
dialogues.en: "She'd be able to recover much faster by resting at home."
dialogues.text: "She'd be able to recover much faster by resting at home."

dialogues.jp:
俺もしばらくことりの後ろ姿を見送った後、背
中を向けた。
dialogues.en:
After some time looking at Kotori's disappearing figure, I
turn my back on the Sakura Avenue.
dialogues.text:
After some time looking at Kotori's disappearing figure, I
turn my back on the Sakura Avenue.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、飯でも食うか」
dialogues.en: "Alright, time for lunch!"
dialogues.text: "Alright, time for lunch!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね」
dialogues.en: "Yes it is!"
dialogues.text: "Yes it is!"

dialogues.jp: 俺の横に美春がついてくる。
dialogues.en: Miharu was at my side, following me.
dialogues.text: Miharu was at my side, following me.

dialogues.jp: 「……ちょっと待て」
dialogues.en: "...Wait a minute."
dialogues.text: "...Wait a minute."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい？　どうかしましたか、朝倉先輩？」
dialogues.en: "Yes? What's wrong, Asakura-senpai?"
dialogues.text: "Yes? What's wrong, Asakura-senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「どうしてお前がついてくるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you coming with me?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you coming with me?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「決まってるじゃないですか。今日は朝倉先輩
　とお昼ご飯を食べようと思って来たんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Isn't it obvious? We're having lunch together this
afternoon."
dialogues.text:
"Isn't it obvious? We're having lunch together this
afternoon."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「決まってないと思うが……。というか、初耳
　だぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"That's not obvious... in fact, it's the first I've heard of
it."
dialogues.text:
"That's not obvious... in fact, it's the first I've heard of
it."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　そうでしたっけ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Really?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Really?"

dialogues.jp: 小首を傾げる美春。
dialogues.en: Miharu tilted her head slightly.
dialogues.text: Miharu tilted her head slightly.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、今言ったので問題なしです！」
dialogues.en: "Then I might as well just say it now!"
dialogues.text: "Then I might as well just say it now!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「一緒にご飯食べましょう、朝倉先輩！」
dialogues.en: "Please eat lunch with me, Asakura-senpai!"
dialogues.text: "Please eat lunch with me, Asakura-senpai!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は──
◆ことりの早退◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori's Early Departure◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori's Early Departure◆

dialogues.jp: 中庭を校門に向かうことりを見かけた。
dialogues.en:
I saw Kotori leave the school through the gate at the
courtyard.
dialogues.text:
I saw Kotori leave the school through the gate at the
courtyard.

dialogues.jp: ｛き／訊｝くと、頭痛がするので早退するという。
dialogues.en:
From my inquiry, I found out that she was leaving school
early due to a headache.
dialogues.text:
From my inquiry, I found out that she was leaving school
early due to a headache.

dialogues.jp:
帰ったことりを心配していると、美春がやって
きて、一緒に昼食を食べようと言ってきた。
dialogues.en:
While worrying about the departing Kotori, Miharu came and
invited me to eat lunch with her.
dialogues.text:
While worrying about the departing Kotori, Miharu came and
invited me to eat lunch with her.

dialogues.jp: さて、どうする？
dialogues.en: Now, what should I do?
dialogues.text: Now, what should I do?

choices.jp: 〇好意を無駄にしない男だ
